arguments.command: echo $GITHUB_RUN_ID $GITHUB_SHA; git log --oneline -3 origin/main 2>/dev/null; timeout 60 gh run list --workflow pi-assistant.yml -L 6 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,createdAt,headSha,displayTitle --jq '.[]|"\(.databaseId) \(.status) \(.conclusion) \(.createdAt) \(.headSha[0:7]) \(.displayTitle)"'
